obernants.domain: Deterministic finite fixture executions and assertion verdict vectors for the adjacent implementation; not an all-input proof.
obernants.operator: In the universe of fixture/verdict pairs, excluded behavior contains a passing verdict when any encoded expected value differs, or a claim of universal correctness from these finite fixtures. The independent oracle enumerates paths rather than reproducing the production scheduling mechanism.
obernants.assumptions: Successful allocations; mathematical path semantics; finite oracle correspondence only.
obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived relation with finite evidence, no formal semantic proof.
